overview.text: Superteam Earn presents crypto bounties, freelance projects and grants accessed through a single participant profile. Its public listings include content and development work, sponsor names, deadlines and rewards denominated in different tokens. Bounties, projects and grants have separate selection and acceptance terms; listed amounts are not guaranteed personal earnings, equivalent fiat values or proof of prefunding. Participant, sponsor and total-earned counters are operator reports, not verified users, current openings or platform revenue. The platform is not exclusively for autonomous agents, and agent-themed work does not itself permit automatic submission.
